text:
AT&T Stadium mepere na Mee 27, 2009 n'okpuru aha mbụ ya, Cowboys Stadium, ụlọ ọhụrụ nke ndị NFL Dallas Cowboys. HKS, Inc. chepụtara ya na ihe ruru ijeri $1.3, e chepụtara ya n'ụzọ dị ukwuu, bụrụkwa ụlọ egwuregwu NFL kacha ibu site n'ọnụọgụ oche. Ihe dị ka oche 80,000 nwere ike gbanwee iji nweta ihe karịrị 100,000, ụlọ ahụ nwere ihe abụọ pụrụ iche: ụlọ elu nwere ike imechi na otu n'ime bọọdụ vidiyo kacha ibu n'ụwa egwuregwu.

Ebe ahụ nwetara aha ya na-adịgide adịgide na 2013, mgbe nkwekọrịta ikike aha na July 25 gbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ AT&T Stadium. Site na mmalite, ọ rụrụ ọrụ karịa otu egwuregwu bọọlụ. Na Febụwarị 2011, ọ nabatara Super Bowl XLV, na kemgbe ahụ ọ nabatala ọtụtụ ihe omume dị mkpa na-abụghị bọọlụ Amerika, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ otu n'ime ebe egwuregwu dị iche iche kacha mma na mba ahụ.

Nke kachasị mkpa, ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ wulitekwara ezigbo aha bọọlụ mba ụwa. Ọ ghọrọ onye na-anabata egwuregwu Concacaf Gold Cup mgbe niile, na na 2024, ọ bụ ebe Copa América, na-eje ozi ugboro ugboro dị ka ala na-anọpụ iche maka asọmpi kọntinent dị elu. Akwụkwọ ndekọ ahụ mere ka ọ dịrị ya mma maka ọkwa ya kachasị ukwuu. Maka 2026 World Cup, FIFA gbanwere aha ebe ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Dallas Stadium ma lekọta mgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ahịhịa eke ewelitere ma gbasaa iji mezuo ụkpụrụ asọmpi, mgbanwe nke mere ka ihe ngosi gridiron a dị ịtụnanya ghọọ ebe egwuregwu bọọlụ zuru ụwa ọnụ.
